_comment: SearXNG data for sources/passive/searx.py and sources/passive/searxbrowser.py. Both modules read this one file: 'instances' is WHERE to search, 'engines' is WHAT each instance searches with. JSON has no comment syntax, so the prose lives in these '_'-prefixed keys - the loader (core/assets.py::load_config_list) reads only the named list and ignores everything else, so notes can be added freely.
_instances_note: Public SearXNG instances, tried in RANDOM order until _WANT_OK of them answer. Instance health varies wildly and is IP-reputation dependent: from a datacenter address most of these answer with an Anubis proof-of-work page, a 'Making sure you're not a bot!' interstitial, a 403, or their own home page - all with HTTP 200. That is exactly why the list is long and the source rotates instead of trusting any single host. Base URL only, no trailing slash and no /search.
_engines_note: Engines to switch ON per instance, sent as SearXNG's `enabled_engines` preference over both a cookie and a URL parameter. A public instance only queries the engines its own settings.yml leaves enabled, and most ship yandex, baidu, sogou, quark, 360search, naver, seznam, mojeek, yacy, wiby and mwmbl as disabled. Selecting categories does NOT turn those on - this list is what does. See sources/passive/searx.py::engine_prefs() for the measured effect.
_engines_format: One 'enginename__category' pair per entry. The category half matters: an entry only counts for a category the engine actually belongs to, so 'yandex__it' is ignored while 'yandex__general' is honoured. Engine names may contain spaces ('ddg definitions'); keep them literal, the callers encode them.
_engines_safety: A stale or wrong entry CANNOT break an instance: SearXNG only flips preference keys it already knows, so an unknown or misspelled name is dropped in silence. That is what makes one shared superset safe across every instance despite differing versions and engine sets - add freely, no per-instance tailoring needed.
_engines_scope: Seeded from a live /preferences capture (2026-08): general-category engines only. The modules also search it/science/files, which still run instance defaults until this list is extended to those categories.
_engines_disable: Emptying this list disables engine expansion entirely and both modules fall back to instance defaults. That is the control arm when re-measuring the gain.
